svg.title: Serverless Security & FaaS Hardening Architecture
svg.desc: Serverless Security diagram showing AWS Lambda cold start execution containers, IAM role scoping, event source mapping validation, and Secrets Manager integration.
svg.text: Ephemeral MicroVM container isolation, granular IAM execution roles, and event validation.
• MicroVM Sandbox (Firecracker): Lightweight container hypervisor isolation per function invocation
• Warm Container Reuse: Retains `/tmp` storage across invocations; sensitive data must be purged
• Stateless Execution: Function handlers must not rely on local file persistence
GRANULAR IAM EXECUTION ROLES & EVENT VALIDATION
• Single-Purpose IAM Roles: One dedicated IAM role per function; avoid shared wildcard admin roles
• Event Source Injection Defense: Validate SQS, S3, API Gateway event payload schemas before parsing
• Secrets Manager Fetching: Fetch database credentials dynamically at runtime via SDK; zero hardcoded keys
DENIAL OF WALLET (DOW) & VPC EGRESS ISOLATION
• Concurrency Limits: Enforce reserved concurrency limits to prevent malicious financial depletion (DoW)
• VPC Integration: Place database-accessing functions inside private subnets with NAT Gateway egress filtering
• Execution Timeouts: Set aggressive timeout limits (e.g. 5–10 seconds max) to terminate hung or exploited tasks
SERVERLESS SECURITY: FIRECRACKER MICROVM → PER-FUNCTION IAM ROLE → CONCURRENCY CAPS → SHORT TIMEOUTS
